---
title: "BooleanNet"
---

booleannet is a Python package for learning and exploring Boolean networks. 
It installs the `bnet` command line tool, that can list models, run simulations, 
draw graphs, and has other functions. It was first published in 2008 as a simulation toolbox for life scientists.

* <https://github.com/ialbert/booleannet>
